verdict.rationale: Termius documents SSH connections, generating Ed25519, ECDSA, and RSA keys, managing SSH keys in the Keychain, importing key files from ~/.ssh, and exporting public keys to authorized_keys, which covers key-based SSH connection with all three types. Community reports confirm real-world SSH use but do not mention specific key types. missing for 10: explicit documentation that each key type authenticates connections (only generation is named per type), independent corroboration of Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA key auth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect to remote servers using SSH with Ed25519, ECDSA, or RSA keys

citations.quote: Termius can generate Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA, and ML-DSA keys.
supports SSH, Mosh, Telnet, Serial, and SFTP
Termius supports importing the contents of the `~/.ssh` folder, including `ssh_config`, `known_hosts`, and key files
Provide a convenient way to export the public keys to the `authorized_keys` file
